fields.label: Provider
fields.help: Open-Meteo needs no account and serves the current conditions and the outlook from one request. OpenWeatherMap needs a key and two.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: OpenWeatherMap only. The free tier allows about 1000 calls a day, which the 10-minute interval floor keeps you inside.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: Required. Both coordinates at 0 is read as 'not set up yet' and no request is made.

fields.label: Outlook columns
fields.help: What the columns on the right of the /kindle forecast row step through: three on the upright page, five on the landscape one. Hourly prints one figure per column; daily prints that day's high and low.

fields.label: Fetch interval
fields.help: Clamped to 10-360. A forecast does not move faster than that, and the floor is what keeps a misconfigured device off a provider's rate limit.
